chest_common._comment: CB-9 treasure chest: one 4-frame strip cut by tools/asset_pipeline/cut_chest_sheets.py. Frame 0 is closed, 3 is open; the two between are the squash-and-stretch of the lid. The anchor is bottom-centre on the chest's baseline (30 of the 32 px cell), so the box stays put while the lid flies up.
